Caption: The same white-and-teal train is stopped beneath the blue fluorescent vaulted Paris metro ceiling; a single pair of doors opens to reveal an empty fluorescent-lit carriage; diffuse mist and the cold wet platform reflect the train in an unnaturally quiet scene.

STYLE.Artistic Medium: photorealistic cinematic digital-video movie still, DV camcorder capture
STYLE.Aesthetic Movement / Genre: psychological horror, supernatural thriller, cinematic noir
STYLE.Cultural / Historical Influence: Paris architecture with early-2000s digital-cinema aesthetic

COMPOSITION.Layout: open train doors in central third, carriage extending into fog
COMPOSITION.Perspective: grounded eye-level or slightly low filmic viewpoint

SCENE.Subject Characteristics: environment-only shot; no human subject, no extra silhouette
SCENE.Setting: same Paris metro platform and same train exterior

CINEMATOGRAPHY_AND_LIGHTING.Lighting Style: cold blue practicals and fluorescent spill from inside open doors
